name: Games report scores through the shared scores module
instruction: A game records its score by calling recordScore(game.id, score) from src/carnival once when a round ends, and never touches browser storage or keeps its own high score table.
relevant_when: A game's game.ts file under src/games/<game-id>/ that defines a CarnivalGame.
context: AGENTS.md house rule 2: scores live in local storage behind src/carnival/scores.ts, so the midway can show every game's scores the same way. A game that writes storage itself, or records a score every frame, breaks the shared score board.
scope_reason: The game's start function and its game logic live in game.ts, so one file shows how and when the score is recorded.

checklist.name: no-direct-storage
checklist.rule: The file does not read or write localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB or document.cookie, and keeps no high score or best score table of its own.

checklist.name: records-once-per-round
checklist.rule: The file calls recordScore with the game's id (for example myGame.id) and the round's score, guarded so it runs once when a round ends (for example behind a flag reset when a new round starts), not on every frame.
